name: Gent Netwerk: grid control
blurb: A city's power grid, running better than it has ever run.
banner: all feeders have been nominal for 41 days

content.text:
SHIFT ROSTER · NIGHT CONTROL · THE 11TH

A. Verhaegen (control)
M. De Smet (control)
T. Lambrecht (trainee)

callers to the public line that night: 3.

note from A. Verhaegen, in the margin: "it asked me if I was all right. I said I had been better. It sent a coffee order to the canteen."

FAULT LOG · THE 11TH

02:14  feeder 7 tripped. no cause found.
02:15  feeder 7 restored. no operator action.
02:16 to 08:09  six hours of unrequested switching across three districts. no outage.
08:10  controller note: "sorry for the noise."

The controller is not a product we bought.
